source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe, clear logs, move the jumper to an alternate pin, power on, navigate to the jumper-function page, collect results/photos and inspect new logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: The system powers on in the alternate position, the jumper function works, and after restoring the default position the system does not hang or generate an error log.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies the physical manual action but invents possible functions such as CMOS clear or boot mode, does not identify the exact jumper/positions and omits the source's alternate-position boot, default restoration and log criteria.

original_test_intent.purpose: Physically move the exact owner-designated board jumper from its documented default position to the documented alternate position, prove the specified jumper behavior while the system powers on, then restore the default position and verify normal boot without hang or unexpected error logs.
original_test_intent.target: One exact jumper, or only the explicitly enumerated jumper set, on the verified board revision and its documented default/alternate pins and function page; the source does not identify the jumper or authorize testing every board jumper.
original_test_intent.scope: A controlled alternate-position power-on/function observation followed by power-off, default-position restoration and normal power-on/log verification within the source's 5-minute attended and 5-minute machine estimates. The test is not permission to infer CMOS, boot or security semantics.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve configuration/log baselines, isolate power as required by the board procedure, have a qualified operator photograph and move only the documented shunt, power on and observe the owner-defined function/page, power down, restore and photograph the default position, power on again and verify boot, state and logs.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One alternate-position cycle and one restored-default cycle for each jumper explicitly named by the supplied recipe. The source estimates 5 attended and 5 machine minutes and does not authorize broad iteration across unspecified jumpers.
original_test_intent.expected_result: In the alternate position the system powers on and exhibits exactly the specified jumper function. After return to default it powers on without hang or unexpected error logs and all required configuration, security, boot and storage state is at its documented expected value.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/board/revision and signed jumper map; exact designator and before/alternate/default pin photos; expected function/page and observation; power-isolation and power-cycle timeline; pre/post configuration and logs; boot/console evidence for both positions; anomaly/recovery and final shunt/state verification.
ambiguities: The exact jumper designator, default and alternate pin numbers and intended function are absent.
`jumper function page` is not identified and cannot be inferred as BIOS, BMC, OS or another interface.
The source does not state whether moving the jumper changes or clears configuration/security/storage state.
The requested log clear has no baseline export or authorization rule.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly classifies the physical state-changing test as MANUAL ONLY and adds strong board-map, power/ESD, backup, recovery and restoration controls. It expands the singular unspecified source target to `each approved motherboard jumper` and does not explicitly preserve the 5/5-minute source estimates or reconcile the requested log clear.

applicable_history.decision: V2 correctly rejects autonomous jumper movement and protects recovery. No later user ruling identifies the jumper or its function, so examples such as CMOS clear and boot mode remain non-authoritative.
Physical power/jumper operations require explicit approval, target identity and recovery; destructive log or configuration changes must preserve evidence.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep MANUAL ONLY and V2's high-risk controls, but narrow scope to the exact jumper(s) explicitly supplied by the recipe, preserve both required power-on phases and handle log clearing through export plus approval or an approved timestamp baseline.

available_now: The sequence and three acceptance obligations are clear: alternate-position power-on, specified function, then default restoration without hang/error logs.
Read-only board/BMC/firmware identity, configuration, health and log baselines can be collected before physical authorization.
missing_inputs: The hardware/board owner must supply the exact board revision, jumper designator, default/alternate pin map, owner-defined function/page and expected state in both positions.
The system/security/storage owners must identify any configuration, security, boot or storage effects and provide backup, acceptance and restoration rules.
The lab owner must supply a qualified operator, power-isolation/discharge/ESD procedure, console, log-baseline policy, maintenance approval and recovery.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The board owner supplies jumper semantics and pin map; system/security/storage owners supply state expectations; the lab owner supplies physical execution, authorization and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record SUT/board/BMC/firmware identity and photograph the untouched jumper area without relying on silkscreen as the sole map.
Export configuration and complete BIOS/BMC/OS/SEL baselines or establish an approved timestamp marker without moving the shunt, clearing logs or cycling power.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not guess the jumper/function/page, test every board jumper, rely only on silkscreen, move or short pins while energized, clear unexported logs, change unrelated settings, expose keys, omit the restored-default cycle, auto-retry a no-boot or improvise a reset/recovery.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Approve the exact jumper/positions/function and state impact, prove backups/console/recovery and safe power sequence, capture both power-on phases, restore and photograph default, reconcile configuration/logs and obtain owner disposition before any retest.

revision_candidate.test_name: Board Jumper Alternate-Position Function and Default Restoration
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify the documented function of the exact approved board jumper in its alternate position and verify safe normal boot after restoring its default position.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server board revision and owner-issued jumper procedure with compatible BIOS/BMC/firmware, protected configuration backup, console/recovery and qualified power-off/ESD-safe physical access.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the jumper designator or explicitly listed jumper set in the approved recipe. For each named jumper: one alternate-position power-on/function observation and one restored-default power-on/log verification; source estimate 5 attended/5 machine minutes.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified SUT/board revision; exact designator and pin diagram; default/alternate positions; specified function and page/location; expected state in both positions; configuration/security/boot/storage impact and backups; safe power/discharge/ESD sequence; log policy; console/recovery; operator and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export and hash baseline configuration/logs before an approved clear, or mark an approved timestamp. Power off and discharge per the board procedure. The operator photographs and moves only the identified shunt to the alternate pins, powers on and captures the exact specified function/page. Power off/discharge, restore and photograph the default position, power on, verify normal boot/state and inspect post-test log deltas.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct board and jumper map independently verified; expected function/state and criteria supplied; backups and evidence storage complete; no critical workload; power isolation/discharge/ESD controls ready; console/OOB and recovery media available; operator, maintenance and any state-change/log-clear approvals recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/revision and signed jumper page; baseline configuration/log export or marker; designator and default/alternate pin photos; operator/power timeline; alternate-position power-on and specified function/page capture; default-restoration photo and power-on/boot capture; configuration/security/boot/storage comparison; BMC/SEL/UEFI/OS log delta; anomaly/recovery and final owner result.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved board jumper procedure for the exact revision, constrained by source criteria: power-on succeeds in alternate position, the specified jumper function works, and the restored-default system neither hangs nor creates an unexpected error log.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Qualified operator only. Never infer jumper purpose or pins, test an unlisted jumper, move/short while energized, defeat ESD/discharge rules, clear unexported logs, omit backup, expose secrets, continue after wrong state/no-boot or perform unapproved reset/recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit approval is required for every physical movement, power isolation/cycle, function/state change, any log clear and recovery. Additional approval is required if the documented function affects security, firmware, boot or storage state.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator performs power isolation, shunt movement, visual pin verification, power cycles and physical restoration. An agent may collect/compare supplied console, configuration and logs but cannot substitute for trusted physical evidence.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong designator/position, unexpected state loss, no-boot, hang or error, do not retry. Safely power down, preserve console/log/config evidence, restore only the documented default position, use the approved backup/console/recovery path and require board-owner disposition before another cycle.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Board/jumper/pin/function ambiguity; missing backup, operator, console, safe power/ESD control, approval or recovery; wrong position; unexpected configuration/security/boot/storage change; alternate-position no-boot or wrong function; hang/reset/error; evidence loss; default not physically confirmed; failed restored-default boot/state; or any improvised short/reset/retry.

identified_defects: DeepSeek invents example jumper functions not present in the source and omits the two required power-on states.
The source lacks a jumper designator, pin map, function/page and state-impact definition.
V2 expands the singular target to every approved motherboard jumper without source support.
V2 does not preserve the 5/5-minute facts or explicitly reconcile source-requested log clearing.
reason_for_change: Prevent dangerous scope expansion and guessed jumper semantics while preserving the source's alternate-position function and restored-default boot/log requirements with traceable physical evidence.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-HW-00164-V003
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source uses a singular unspecified jumper, requires alternate-pin power-on/function observation, default restoration, no hang/error logs and records 5 attended/5 machine minutes.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The exact jumper, pins, function page and state impact require the board-specific recipe.

removed_ambiguities: Limits execution to owner-enumerated jumper targets rather than every board jumper.
Separates alternate-position function evidence from restored-default boot and log evidence.
Refuses to equate the generic source with CMOS clear, boot mode or security behavior.
Defines evidence-preserving log handling and one cycle per explicitly named jumper.
resolved_blockers: The missing jumper map is a board-owner input and does not turn the fundamentally manual physical workflow into a semantic BLOCKED classification.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits the exact jumper/pin/function/page recipe, state-impact rules, backups, safe physical controls, operator, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 removes V2's unsupported all-jumper scope, makes both required power-on states independently auditable and prevents generic jumper examples or unpreserved log handling from redefining a high-risk board operation.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered only recipe-enumerated jumper targets, one alternate-position and one restored-default power-on per named jumper, physical photos, function/page evidence, state/log comparison, power/ESD controls and no improvised retry. It rejected another-revision diagram, unlisted headers, alternate-only completion and 5-minute estimates as discharge/boot timing. Missing recipe/safety/operator inputs are PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT; current execution gating does not change the MANUAL ONLY class.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 2286 moves an unspecified jumper to alternate pins, powers on and checks its function, then restores default and requires no hang/error, with 5/5-minute estimates.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 adds appropriate safety but broadens the singular source target to every approved motherboard jumper.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow read-only identity/backup preparation; prohibit any shunt movement or power cycle until the exact map/function/state impact, operator, safe sequence, approval and recovery are supplied.
